name: Rollout slider
oneLiner: a dark glass feature-flag panel: a big percent and a people count roll as a glossy knob is grabbed and dragged from Off to each rollout step, then at 100 the track, the numbers and the status pill flip to green with a stamp and a ring
say: when the speaker says they released something slowly and then to everyone ('one percent first, then ten, then everyone'): the knob steps on each number and the panel goes green on 'everyone'
